pre_report_direction.contract_note: Chat-first v2 replaces form-based pre-report presentation while preserving the same validated FEAT-004 data and completion contract.

screens.name: Landing Page — Base
screens.description: Education-led landing page that previews the style report, process, trust terms, and primary conversion action.

screens.name: Account Access — Unauthenticated
screens.description: Unified Google and email magic-link access that signs up or logs in and provides a route back to anonymous report onboarding.

screens.name: Personal Profile — Base
screens.description: Chat-first profile collection for name, adult confirmation, gender, age, height, and optional weight with disclosed gender consent.

screens.name: Brand and Size Profile — Base
screens.description: Favorite-brand selection with distinct known, unknown, or not-applicable sizes by garment type.

screens.name: Outfit Photo Upload — Empty
screens.description: Photo guidance, analysis consent, upload entry, count rules, and image-use explanation before any image is selected.

screens.name: Outfit Photo Upload — Partial
screens.description: Grid of uploaded and validating images with count progress, replacement, removal, and continue behavior.

screens.name: Outfit Photo Upload — Validation Error
screens.description: Local image rejection state that preserves successful uploads and explains replacement.

screens.name: Taste Calibration — Base
screens.description: Tinder-like look or garment card: right/Love, left/Hate, and down/Maybe, with matching buttons, keyboard controls, undo, and progress.

screens.name: Taste Calibration — Recovery
screens.description: Failed-card recovery state that preserves earlier taste choices.

screens.name: Account Connection — Base
screens.description: Unified Google and email magic-link step that creates or logs into a permanent account and connects anonymous progress before report generation.

screens.name: Account Connection — Magic Link Sent
screens.description: Magic-link waiting and recovery state; the link signs up or logs in and connects preserved anonymous progress after authentication.

screens.name: Style Report Analysis — Processing
screens.description: Meaningful real-analysis stages, time expectation, safe-exit behavior, and current photo-lifecycle reminder.
primary_actions: Notify me when it is ready

screens.name: Style Report Analysis — Slow
screens.description: Post-120-second state confirming continued processing, preserved inputs, email notification, and safe exit.

screens.name: Style Report Analysis — Error Recovery
screens.description: Normalized analysis failure with preserved-input summary, retry, support, and replacement guidance when required.

screens.name: Style Report — Overview
screens.description: Affirming style identity, strongest patterns, prioritized opportunities, report navigation, and next styling action.

screens.name: Style Report — Color
screens.description: Personal palette, neutrals, accents, combinations, text equivalents, explanations, and feedback.

screens.name: Style Report — Body Style
screens.description: Kibbe-informed profile, visual rationale, confidence, practical implications, and recalibration path.

screens.name: Style Report — Recommendations
screens.description: Prioritized styling guidance plus AI-generated customer-likeness wardrobe previews linked to current real products when quality, consent, and image-use permission pass, with complete text-and-link fallback.

screens.name: Style Home — Base
screens.description: Returning-customer home with report highlights, selected recommendations, live styling entry, bag, and account access.

screens.name: Live Styling — Camera Permission
screens.description: Purpose-specific camera request for live visualization and hand-gesture controls, with environment guidance, visualization limitation, and denial recovery.

screens.name: Live Styling — Ready
screens.description: Live camera view with active garment visualization, product identity, voice status, hand-gesture status, direct alternatives, and bag controls.

screens.name: Live Styling — Microphone Permission
screens.description: Separate microphone permission explanation with direct-control alternative.

screens.name: Live Styling — Voice Listening
screens.description: Live-session overlay showing that voice capture is active, with cancel and direct-control alternatives.

screens.name: Live Styling — Hand Gesture Guide
screens.description: Distance-control guide and active interpretation overlay showing supported hand gestures, camera framing, recognition state, intended action, and consequential-action confirmation.

screens.name: Recommended Product — Detail Drawer
screens.description: Product detail, report rationale, size context, retailer provenance, known price and availability, and session-preserving actions.

screens.name: Magic Mirror Bag — Base
screens.description: Selected products grouped by retailer with availability, external-checkout boundaries, and removal controls.

screens.name: Retailer Handoff — Confirmation
screens.description: Final confirmation that identifies retailer ownership of checkout, stock, price, fulfillment, and returns before navigation.

screens.name: Personal Profile — Validation Error
screens.description: Field-specific validation that preserves valid personal-profile entries and optional-field choices.

screens.name: Account Connection — Error Recovery
screens.description: Interrupted or failed Google or magic-link connection with anonymous progress preserved.

screens.name: Style Report — Feedback and Recalibration
screens.description: Correction and recalibration state shared by report findings.

screens.name: Style Home — Resume or Recover
screens.description: Returning-customer home when incomplete or failed work needs a specific resume or recovery action.

screens.name: Live Styling — Camera Denied
screens.description: Camera-denial recovery that preserves selected items, report access, and device guidance.

screens.name: Live Styling — Connecting
screens.description: Live visualization connection state with selected product preserved.

screens.name: Live Styling — Changing Item
screens.description: In-session state while a new recommended item is being applied.

screens.name: Live Styling — Slow
screens.description: Explicit slow state for an awaited live visualization update.

screens.name: Live Styling — Error Recovery
screens.description: Normalized live-provider failure with retry and preserved product selection.

screens.name: Live Styling — Ended
screens.description: Completed-session summary with preserved selections and next actions.

screens.name: Live Styling — Voice Interpreting
screens.description: Voice request interpretation state layered over the live session.

screens.name: Live Styling — Voice Confirmation
screens.description: Interpreted voice request shown for confirmation before action.

screens.name: Live Styling — Voice Acting
screens.description: Confirmed voice request being applied to the recommended item set.

screens.name: Live Styling — Voice Failure
screens.description: Unrecognized or unmatched voice request with retry and direct-control recovery.

screens.name: Live Styling — Gesture Observing
screens.description: Active hand-gesture observation with camera-framing guidance.

screens.name: Live Styling — Gesture Interpreting
screens.description: Recognized hand shape shown with the intended action before acting.

screens.name: Live Styling — Gesture Accepted
screens.description: Accepted non-consequential gesture with action feedback.

screens.name: Live Styling — Gesture Ignored or Unavailable
screens.description: Ignored, unrecognized, or unavailable gesture state with positioning and alternative-control recovery.

screens.name: Live Styling — Gesture Confirmation
screens.description: Explicit confirmation before a gesture triggers a consequential action.

screens.name: Recommended Product — Unavailable
screens.description: Unavailable recommended-product state with alternatives and preserved context.

screens.name: Bag — Item Unavailable
screens.description: Bag state that identifies an unavailable item and offers removal or alternatives.
